svg.text: How the detector follows a shot: Shot 5, from the tare to the pump stop
Time since the tare. The spikes of the two clicks are taken out, they come from pressing the button.
walks back to where the average left rest
dots: readings · line: average over 0.3 s · grey: rest ±1σ
Watch, 10 s: the flow over 0.25 s (light) stays in the band:
the flow over 2 s ± 2.2 g/s. Over the floor, on average under 5 g/s.
shot running: waits for the pump stop
counted from the first drop − 7.0 s
shown, running: 25.8 s at the pump stop
actual pump start (click), 6.1 s before the first drop
Rejected during the watch (not smooth, under the floor, over 5 g/s): the detector waits again once the weight is steady at 0 g.
A bump comes back there; beans or a cup never do, so they wait for the next tare. A missed shot is started by a click.
